Messages.Author: Malcolm McCallum
Messages.Body:
I've now seen the worst/best case for/against Return to Innocence as a
game breaker. My Giovanni were hanging on by their fingernails with one
blood after my fighting desperately to keep myself in the game against
the nasty Malkavians. My Prey was a Toreador vote deck sitting with 12
blood. My Malkavian ends his attacks, exhausted, overextends himself and
brings out Leandro. Things look bad until...

Malkavian Dementia on Leandro and then Return to Innocence with a
hint of stealth. Can you say 'I bleed for 14'? Can you say 'Burn one
fresh IC vampire'?

Things might be out of whack.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
